sentences.text: This salmon shark carried its tag for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Salmon sharks keep their bodies warmer than the surrounding water, which lets them hunt in cold northern seas.
Its track spans from {northernmost_lat} down to {southernmost_lat}, and its daily positions add up to {path_km}.
Its farthest point from the start, {max_displacement_km} away, came on {farthest_date}.
The record has one long silence: {longest_gap_days} without a position.
